title: Full-adder gate construction
statement: Given natural-number labels $a,b,c_{\mathrm{in}},L$, define a gate list by concatenating the four-gate exclusive OR construction on $a,b$ at label $L$, the four-gate construction on $L+3,c_{\mathrm{in}}$ at label $L+4$, and a final OR gate reading $L+1,L+5$.
